info.name: Platform API V1 Appointments API Tracking API API
List Tracking Events for a tracking code

items.docs: Returns the tracking history for a tracking code, in ascending chronological order by `occurred_at`. Covers two journeys - outbound kit delivery and inbound sample return (see the `tracking_code` parameter and `status` for detail). Returns an empty collection if no events are available, including when the feature is not yet enabled for your organisation.
